answer: Canopy radar attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to spatial Doppler signatures. Ground nodes pulse microwave signals toward a falcon drone patrolling a cedar woodland and record the backscattered echo. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of deploying separate physical transceivers at distinct coordinates per identity. However, wet foliage heavily attenuates microwave signals, causing false rejections of honest agents.
